title: Ideal-module multiplication image and its inclusion
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $J,F$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $i:J\to\mathcal O_X$ be a morphism of modules; $i$ is not required to be injective. Using the sheaf tensor product and its unit [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], form $\mu_{i,F}:J\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}F\xrightarrow{i\otimes1}\mathcal O_X\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}F\xrightarrow{\lambda_F}F$. Define the ideal-module product $JF=\operatorname{im}(\mu_{i,F})$ and its inclusion $JF\hookrightarrow F$ to be the image object and image inclusion in the abelian category of module sheaves. When $i$ is an ideal inclusion, this is the usual ideal multiple; the same definition applies to the pulled-back ideal map even when that map is not injective.
